title: The Brilliant AI Social Media System Alex Hormozi Is Using to Win
description:
This is the exact system Alex Hormozi uses to 10x his content output without sacrificing quality

🐦 Get the Tweet Prompt: https://joindreamlabs.com/hormozi/tweet-prompt.html
📚 All prompts preview: https://joindreamlabs.com/hormozi/prompts-preview.html

450 pieces of content a week. Tweets 7x faster. YouTube scripts down from 2 hours to 15 minutes. We reverse engineered his exact AI content workflow and ran it live, feeding Claude all 6,630 of his tweets and watching it write in his voice. Then we used his exact YouTube prompt to generate a full script in under a minute.

In this video we cover:
🗂️ The AI asset folder system that makes it all work
🐦 Twitter workflow, live demo
🎬 YouTube script workflow, live demo
📱 Short form content workflow breakdown
